_comentario: Assets del prototipo. Z-Image-Turbo (Alibaba/Tongyi) genera la imagen de referencia y Hunyuan3D-2 (Tencent) la convierte en malla texturizada. 'escala' fija el tamaño real en metros (eje 'alto' = Y, 'largo' = mayor dimensión horizontal). 'grupo' define la calidad: grande (octree 384, textura 2K), mediano y chico. 'lote' ordena la generación (A primero). Prompts basados en el relevamiento histórico (pampa bonaerense, ~1872).
prefijo_prompt: isolated object on a plain pure white background,
sufijo_prompt: , full view of the whole object with empty white margin around it, centered, three-quarter view from slightly above, soft even diffuse studio lighting, no cast shadow, photorealistic, highly detailed textures, no text, no people

assets.prompt: humble 1870s Argentine pampas rancho: one-room rectangular hut, thick hand-plastered mud-and-straw adobe walls in earthy ochre with cracks, steep two-pitch roof thatched with thick pale-yellow straw and totora reed bundles tied in rows, crooked log ridge beam and rafter ends under short eaves, low doorway covered by a hanging dried cowhide, one small unglazed window hole

19th-century small-bodied Spanish gut-string guitar (guitarra criolla) standing upright, aged spruce top with simple rosette and tie bridge, dark rosewood back and sides, slotted headstock, worn varnish, full-length view of the whole guitar from headstock to bottom

ground-level campfire hearth on a small round patch of bare earth: shallow bed of grey ash and glowing black charcoal, several charred branches crossed in the center, dry thistle stalks, a loose ring of rounded field stones around it, no flames, no smoke

Argentine asado a la cruz: a forged dark iron cross-shaped roasting spit planted in the ground at a slight angle, holding a large whole rack of beef ribs (costillar) roasted golden-brown and crispy, tied with wire

Criollo horse standing square, compact muscular stocky body, short strong legs, deep chest, blue-roan coat (moro) with black head, black mane, black tail and black lower legs, wearing a simple rawhide bridle, calm, all four legs clearly visible, side three-quarter view

giant solitary ombu tree of the Argentine pampa (Phytolacca dioica): an enormously thick, swollen, bulbous pale-grey trunk base much wider than a man, like a giant elephant foot, with massive snaking buttress roots spreading over the ground, short thick trunk dividing into several heavy twisted branches, broad dense rounded umbrella-shaped crown of glossy dark-green leaves, the whole tree wider than it is tall

old 19th-century Argentine ox cart (carreta criolla) of rough weathered wood, two huge spoked wooden wheels taller than a man, arched roof covered with dried leather hides and straw mats, long wooden draft pole resting on the ground in front
pear-shaped dried calabash gourd mate cup with a worn thin silver rim, heaped with green yerba mate, silver bombilla straw with flattened mouthpiece leaning out
19th-century straight-sided copper kettle (caldera) with an arched bail handle and a short spout, hammered aged copper with green patina spots, soot-blackened bottom, small dents
sun-bleached horse skull resting on its lower edge, used as a low stool, weathered cracked ivory bone
fallen weathered tree log with thick rough grey-brown bark and a few broken branch stubs, lying on the ground, used as a rustic bench

a low flat stack of riding pads lying on the ground: a folded striped red and black wool blanket at the bottom, two long rolled brown leather pads side by side on top of it, and a thick fluffy cream-white sheepskin draped over everything, a rawhide strap with an iron ring hanging at one side
lean criollo farm dog lying down and resting with head up, short tan and white coat, alert ears, calm and dignified
small old black felt cordobes hat: low cylindrical crown with a perfectly flat top, short flat straight brim, plain black band, worn and dusty
rustic open-sided shade shelter (enramada) of four crooked forked tree-trunk posts, cross poles lashed with rawhide thongs, flat roof of piled dry branches and loose straw, bare earth floor

traditional Argentine dome-shaped mud and straw bread oven (horno de barro) on a low square adobe brick base, small arched opening with a wooden door leaning beside it, weathered earth-colored clay with cracks

Criollo horse standing calmly, compact muscular body, line-backed dun coat (gateado) with dark dorsal stripe, black mane and tail, wearing a flat Argentine gaucho recado with no saddle horn: a thick fluffy white sheepskin cover lying flat on its back over a striped wool blanket, rawhide girth, rawhide bridle and simple iron stirrups, all four legs clearly visible, side three-quarter view
rustic hitching rail (palenque): two thick weathered hardwood posts planted in the ground joined by a long horizontal log beam, a coiled rawhide lasso hanging from the beam
handwoven pampa wool poncho draped over a rough wooden fence rail on two posts, natural cream and dark brown with red stepped geometric bands, fringed ends
raw cowhide stretched and tied with rawhide thongs on a rectangular frame of rough wooden poles, standing upright, drying in the sun, brown and white hair side out
old wooden water barrel with rusty iron hoops and a wooden lid, a hanging tin ladle, weathered staves
three-meter straight section of rustic corral fence made of irregular rough vertical tree-trunk posts set side by side in the ground, grey weathered wood
criollo longhorn cow standing and grazing with head down to the grass, reddish-brown and white spotted coat, curved horns, all four legs visible, side three-quarter view
greater rhea (nandu) standing, shaggy grey-brown plumage, long neck, strong grey legs
wild cardoon thistle (cardo de Castilla, Cynara cardunculus): rosette of large deeply lobed spiny silvery-grey-green leaves, tall ribbed stems with spiny violet-blue globular flower heads

southern lapwing (tero) standing on the ground: grey head with thin black crest, black throat stripe joining black breast band, white belly, grey-brown back with bronze-green shoulder sheen, pinkish legs
chimango caracara bird perched on top of a single thick weathered wooden post standing alone, no wire, no fence: mottled brown plumage, paler underparts, small pale-grey bill
